_doc: The control schemes for choosing an element's moves (the owner, 2026-10-05, after playing: "still difficult for a human to switch spells, there's a lot of things going on"; round 2's skills: one button one meaning, Keys the default and the others under Controls' other ways). LMB's jab, E's guard, Space, the lock, the grow, the passives are the same under every scheme; only how 1-4's moves are readied differs. MatchSetup.scheme() / set_scheme() (GameSettings' match section, key scheme; a kept 'simple' reads as 'first_moves'), SwayCaster (the routing), Hotbar, BendStrip, RadialWheel, the menus, HowTo and F1 read this file. Every word here is shown to the player: no word from any show. Bots are never affected.

keys.label: Keys
keys.line: 1-4 a move, tap the key twice for its other move; E guards; 5 heals
keys.f1: 1-4 a key's first move, tap twice: its other move · E your guard · 5 Patch (twice: Mend) · hold 2 longer: it grows

direction.label: Direction
direction.line: the key held as you press the right button picks the move: W strike, S wall, A/D dash
direction.strip: press RMB holding  W strike · S wall · A/D dash · nothing: the readied move
direction.f1: Press RMB holding W: your strike · S: your wall · A or D: your dash · nothing held: the readied move (picked at the press; moving after changes nothing)

radial.label: Wheel
radial.line: hold %s: your moves round a wheel; point at one, let go to ready it
radial.strip: hold %s: the wheel · point, let go · RMB: cast
radial.f1: Hold %s: your moves round a wheel · point at one, let go to ready it · 1-5 still pick a key

first_moves.label: First moves only
first_moves.line: 1-4 ready only each key's first move: the same game, fewer choices
first_moves.strip: 1-4 a move · E your guard · 5 Patch
first_moves.f1: 1-4 each key's first move only (a second tap does nothing) · E your guard · 5 Patch

basic.label: Basic
basic.line: left click jabs · 1 or 2, then right-click casts · E guards · Space jumps · 3 dashes
basic.strip: 1 or 2 readies · hold right-click: aim, let go to cast · thrown? hold Space: back you come
basic.f1: Left click: your jab · 1 your strike, tap twice: its partner · 2 your push, hold right-click longer: it grows · right-click casts the readied move · E: tap on the beat, hold to keep it up · Space jumps, again in the air · 3 dashes · thrown off? hold Space
basic.later_line: Wall (4) and Heal (5) come in after your first win

controls._doc: Round 4 SIMPLE: the Controls preset (MatchSetup.controls(): 'basic' a new player's default, 'full' every key and option and the schemes above; GameSettings' match section, key controls). Basic plays the 'basic' scheme's keys with the keys scheme's routing (MatchSetup.scheme() is 'keys' under it; 'basic' is never in 'order') and RingAssist does the hard parts (data/ring/assist.json). Every word shown to the player.

lines.basic: seven keys; thrown off, hold Space and you come back; the edge climbs for you
lines.full: every key and move: dodges, rolls, the edge's choices, and other ways to pick moves

offer._doc: The game's first launch offers the Basics once (the main menu: RingAssist.offer_basics).
offer.title: New here?
offer.line: Five short cards, each done by doing it: walk up and click, ready and cast, guard, push it off, get back.
offer.go_line: a practice against a dummy, about five minutes

direction._doc: The move cast when the right button is pressed with a direction held, sampled at the press and kept for that lock (forward W: key 1's first move, back S: key 4's, the wall; side A or D: key 3's first, the dash to that side; none: the readied move). Each [move, variation]. A touch version maps the directions to swipes.

radial._doc: The wheel's key is the action bend_wheel (Tab by default: unused in the ring; in the duel it takes Tab from the character screen while this scheme is on). The game runs on at full speed while it is open, as the equip wheel (the owner: no slow motion on a wheel).

first_moves._doc: 'First moves only' (replaces Simple and its distance band; owner question 17): keys 1-4 ready only their first move (a second tap, a wheel step: nothing), the strip four names. Each element's four, [move, variation] in key order: the first move of keys 1-4 (moves.json elements), a complete kit with the guard on E.
